fieldCompletionGuidance:
For draft requests, provide fields marked requiredForDraft. Publish requests must provide all fields marked required.

Required organizer project fields may be omitted from drafts but must have matching non-empty projectFieldAnswers before publishing.

Optional fields should still be filled when the user has the information; complete submissions are easier to judge.

Pictures must be real screenshots of the running project, not generated stand-ins.
submissionValidationNotes: Hackathon drafts may omit publish-only fields and remain below publish minimums; maximums and supplied-value formats still apply.
Publish name length: 2-50 characters; draft maximum: 50 characters.
Publish tagline length: 2-50 characters; draft maximum: 50 characters.
Publish commit length: 2-50 characters; draft maximum: 50 characters.

toolInputGuide.description: Project name. Publish name length: 2-50 characters; draft maximum: 50 characters.
Tagline. Publish tagline length: 2-50 characters; draft maximum: 50 characters.
Commit object. Publish commit message length: 2-50 characters; draft maximum: 50 characters.
Technologies array. Draft count may be 0-10; publish count must be 1-10.
Target platforms. Draft count may be 0-5; publish count must be 0-5.
Storage paths or URLs for real project screenshots. Draft count may be 0-6; publish count must be 1-6.
Project links. Draft count may be 0-5; publish count must be 0-5. Include a public repository URL when available.
Project logo storage path or URL.
Cover image storage path or URL.
Array of { projectFieldUUID, value }; required organizer fields must be covered.

projectFields.name: The problem it solves
projectFields.description: Describe the use case and how your agent's workflow addresses it. Explain which AgntID controls you used, where they apply, and what changed as a result. Include a before-and-after example to show the impact.

projectFields.name: Challenges we ran into
projectFields.description: tell us about any specific bug or hurdle you ran into while building this project. how did you get over it? (markdown supported)
